```yaml
name: Release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Override version (e.g., v2.28.0)'
        required: false
        default: ''
      bump:
        description: 'Bump type when version is empty'
        required: false
        default: 'minor'
        type: choice
        options:
          - major
          - minor
          - patch

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      packages: write
      id-token: write

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: true

      - name: Run tests
        run: go test ./...

      - name: Determine version
        id: version
        run: |
          set -e
          latest=$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 2>/dev/null || echo "v0.0.0")
          if [ -n "${{ inputs.version }}" ]; then
            new_version=${{ inputs.version }}
          else
            ver=${latest#v}
            IFS='.' read -r major minor patch <<< "$ver"
            case "${{ inputs.bump }}" in
              major) major=$((major+1)); minor=0; patch=0 ;;
              minor) minor=$((minor+1)); patch=0 ;;
              patch) patch=$((patch+1)) ;;
              *) minor=$((minor+1)); patch=0 ;;
            esac
            new_version="v${major}.${minor}.${patch}"
          fi
          echo "new_version=$new_version" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Install git-cliff
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@v2
        with:
          name: git-cliff
          version: 2.12.0

      - name: Generate CHANGELOG.md
        run: |
          git-cliff --config cliff.toml --output CHANGELOG.md --tag ${{ steps.version.outputs.new_version }}

      - name: Commit CHANGELOG and tag
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add CHANGELOG.md
          git commit -m "chore: update changelog for ${{ steps.version.outputs.new_version }}"
          git tag -a ${{ steps.version.outputs.new_version }} -m "Release ${{ steps.version.outputs.new_version }}"
          git push origin ${{ steps.version.outputs.new_version }}
          git push origin HEAD

      - name: Release with Goreleaser
        uses: goreleaser/goreleaser-action@v6
        with:
          version: latest
          args: release --clean
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
